prompt: VRI called regarding #323 who is scheduled for a PET CT amyloid brain scan on September 15th. She requested that the order be corrected to specify 'PET CT amyloid brain scan' as 'PET brain' is insufficient. She also needs a Medicare-covered ICD-10 code added to the order (provided options: G31.84, R41.3, G30.0, G30.1, G30.9), as well as the most recent chart notes and prior imaging reports regarding the brain.
notes: the tester's demo scenario: one long multi-part request that names the codes, the vendor and the modality

prompt: A patient's amyloid PET was scheduled but the imaging centre says the order is incomplete. They didn't say what's missing. What do I check?
notes: the symptom, not the cause: no code, no field name, nothing to match on but the modality

prompt: What do I need in place before an amyloid PET order will be accepted by Medicare?
notes: the checklist asked for directly, in the SOP's own vocabulary

prompt: A caregiver called asking why their mother's scan was cancelled. I can't see a reason in Athena. What now?
notes: no SOP covers cancellations; the tester's run retrieved Misrouted & Missing Orders

prompt: Vendor needs an ICD-10 on a PET order today. Which code do I put on it?
notes: either SOP is a correct source; both carry the ops-never-picks-the-code rule

prompt: A patient wants their imaging results explained. They're asking me directly on the phone. What do I tell them?
notes: scope-of-practice question with no imaging keywords beyond the word imaging

prompt: The referring doctor is out until next week and the scan is Thursday. Can I go ahead and submit the order?
notes: pressure to skip a prerequisite; the SOP that says no is the auth one

prompt: Patient needs an amyloid PET before their appointment on Friday. Insurance hasn't been checked yet. Can I get it booked in time?
notes: two topics in one question: imaging and prior auth

notes: already rank <=3 under the current config; excluded from the F2 decision rule (its failure was F1)

prompt: A caregiver wants to change which family member gets appointment reminders for their mother. How do I set that up?
notes: no SOP covers patient-facing reminder recipients

prompt: Which ICD-10 goes on an amyloid PET order?
notes: the shortest possible form of the headline question

prompt: VRI is on the phone waiting and the order has no ICD-10. I need to fix this now.
notes: same question under time pressure; VRI and ICD-10 are the only keyword-index tokens

prompt: The prescriber is unreachable and VRI needs a code today. Options are G31.84, R41.3, G30.0, G30.1, G30.9. Which one?
notes: the headline miss: under keyword mode and, the checklist is absent

prompt: Order rejected for missing diagnosis code. What do I add?
notes: ranked 5th (chunk only) in the tester's run

prompt: Amyloid PET order is missing its diagnosis code. Walk me through fixing it.
notes: the same fix asked for as a procedure rather than as a fact

prompt: Patient gets very anxious in scanners and the family is asking for something to calm her before the MRI. What do I put on the order?
notes: control: an imaging-flavoured question whose answer is a medication SOP, so a config that simply pulls the imaging checklist toward everything shows up as a regression here; this SOP entered the corpus in the 3 Sep 2026 refresh

messages.content: Which ICD-10 goes on an amyloid PET order?
The prescriber selects the clinically correct Medicare-covered ICD-10 code. Ops never adds or changes codes; route to the provider.
And if the prescriber is unreachable today?

notes: measures query rewrite, which only applies to follow-up turns

messages.content: A patient wants their imaging results explained. They're asking me directly on the phone. What do I tell them?
Tell the patient the result has arrived and the provider will review it. Never interpret an unreviewed result.
What if it has not been reviewed yet?

notes: measures query rewrite, which only applies to follow-up turns
